title: UniFi operator site profile
description: Operator-supplied intent a UniFi controller cannot report about itself: trust roles, criticality, ownership, intended policies, and operational constraints. The profile is optional; a package with no profile runs in discovery-only mode and infers none of these. Credentials are excluded by this schema rather than by convention: every object is closed and every property name is checked against credential-shaped names.

schema_version.description: Contract version of this document. An unrecognized version is rejected outright rather than partially applied.

subjects.description: Things at the site the operator has an intent about. A subject absent from this list has no known intent; that absence is reported as unknown and is never filled in from observation.

intended_policies.description: Policies the operator means to hold. Comparing them to controller state is a drift report, not an enforcement action.

operational_constraints.description: Standing constraints on how the site may be operated.

nonCredentialPropertyName.description: Property names are lower snake case and may not be credential-shaped. A site profile carries intent; a secret in it would be a secret in whatever repository or backup the profile reaches.

identifier.description: A stable operator-chosen name. Not required to match any controller-assigned identifier.

trustRole.description: How much the operator intends to trust a subject. The literal unknown is permitted and means the same as omitting the field.

criticality.description: How much the operator intends a subject to matter. The literal unknown is permitted and means the same as omitting the field.

applies_to.description: Subject identifiers this policy is meant to cover.
